title: Shared header, footer, navigation and search entry
sectionOrder: Brand and primary links > collection menu > search > language control > saved pieces > footer and protected contacts
acceptance: Escape closes menus and restores focus. Keyboard can reach all destinations. At 320px menus scroll internally and contact values wrap.

title: Homepage `/`
sectionOrder: Full-height hero > point of view > three worlds > selected forms > all-category index > material chapter > atelier chapter > room context > bespoke brief > four steps > principles > journal > invitation
acceptance: Saved homepage preview and public renderer must match at the exact revision. Product selections resolve existing IDs. Every enabled chapter has a heading and a working CTA.

title: Collectible design `/collectible-design`
sectionOrder: Collection introduction > featured visual > browse anchor > filter chips and sort > product grid > form index > scale-planning chapter > materials > process link > FAQ > brief invitation
acceptance: Filters, counts, paging and Back agree. Selected filter chips remain visible. Price-on-request records never gain an invented price.

title: Memory art `/memory-art`
sectionOrder: Memory introduction > preservation doorway > browse > occasion guidance > what to discuss > condition questions > process > care link > related journal > invitation
acceptance: Memory filters remain tier-scoped; personalization questions retain conditional logic. No unsupported longevity or preservation promise is introduced.

title: Personal art `/personal-art`
sectionOrder: Personal-gift introduction > gifts doorway > browse > occasion and recipient chapters > lettering guidance > quantity discussion > process > related journal > invitation
acceptance: Personal-art options and quantity validation remain unchanged; original IDs and galleries resolve correctly after filtering and saving.

title: Search and catalogue discovery `/search`
sectionOrder: Search field > count and current query > applied chips > sort > result grid > paging > empty-state reset > links to all three collections
acceptance: Query, filters and page are shareable in the URL. Clear one chip preserves other filters. Back restores the prior result set and scroll context.

title: Product detail `/pieces/[slug]`
sectionOrder: Compact breadcrumb > original gallery and title/specification column > existing action controls > factual details > dimensions and options > care > related pieces > brief invitation
acceptance: Gallery order, captions, originals, Arrow/Home/End/Escape and focus return remain correct. Main product action is near the gallery, not below a blank screen.

title: Product customization `/pieces/[slug]/customize`
sectionOrder: Product context > step navigation > current options > references > contact details > review > save request > explicit WhatsApp handoff
acceptance: Initial load remains at heading; Next/error moves focus deliberately. Back retains answers. Retry does not create duplicate requests; private references stay private.

title: Commission entry `/commission`
sectionOrder: Commission introduction > choose an existing piece or bespoke path > what to bring > four-step journey > expectations from approved content > FAQ > contact
acceptance: Both paths are keyboard accessible. Links preserve the intended product or bespoke context. No deposit, price or deadline is fabricated.

title: Bespoke request `/commission/customize`
sectionOrder: Brief purpose > dimensions if known > style and colours > private references > contact > review > saved receipt
acceptance: No initial autofocus jump. All failures retain entered values. Upload retry, schema-change review and manual-send semantics remain unchanged.

title: Saved-request receipt `/inquiry/received`
sectionOrder: Saved reference > server-confirmed status > summary > prepared message > Open WhatsApp / Copy > next steps > safe return link
acceptance: Reload is safe; private receipt tokens never appear in screenshots or reports. Copy failure offers selectable text. Message preparation failure leaves the saved brief recoverable.

title: Atelier story `/our-story`; alias `/about`
sectionOrder: Atelier point of view > material relationship > personal stories > design conversation > genuine maker proof if supplied > values > process > invitation
acceptance: Each chapter can be edited, previewed and recovered. Missing proof removes the proof module instead of leaving fabricated staff or awards.

title: Process `/process`
sectionOrder: Opening > choose starting point > describe preferences > save the brief > start the conversation > material discussion > practical questions > invitation
acceptance: All four steps readable without animation. Reduced motion uses a simple vertical list. Sticky imagery must release before the footer and never cover text.

title: Materials and care `/materials-care`; aliases `/materials`, `/care`
sectionOrder: Materials introduction > timber > resin > finish dialogue > use and placement > approved care guidance > questions > related journal
acceptance: Material and care anchors resolve from other pages. Advice is sourced to reviewed content. Tables reflow; print view remains legible.

title: Architects and collaborators `/architects`
sectionOrder: Project-context introduction > what to prepare > scale and access > materials dialogue > collaboration steps > reference brief > contact
acceptance: Architect CTA reaches the correct brief. No unsupported BIM/download/trade program is activated. Visual diagrams have text equivalents.

title: Journey aliases `/preserve`, `/personalize`
sectionOrder: Preserve or personalize landing context > current destination > collection introduction > brief path
acceptance: Alias behavior and canonical destination agree with the registry; unsupported legacy product identities do not guess a replacement.

title: Portfolio index `/portfolio`
sectionOrder: Portfolio introduction > genuine project index or honest empty state > selection criteria > commission invitation
acceptance: No invented clients, project locations or completion years. Empty state is accessible; unapproved detail records remain unavailable.

title: Project detail `/portfolio/[slug]`
sectionOrder: Approved project title > context > brief > constraints > design response > details > factual outcome > credits > related project
acceptance: Unknown project slugs return 404. Publication requires real evidence and image permission; title, gallery and credits are versioned.

title: Journal index `/journal`
sectionOrder: Editorial introduction > featured story > categories > article grid > paging > related collection invitation
acceptance: Only published articles appear. Category filters and paging survive Back. Reading time is derived; no fabricated author/date or newsletter signup.

title: Journal article `/journal/[slug]`
sectionOrder: Article title > actual metadata > lead image > table of contents if long > chapters > image captions > related reading > relevant brief CTA
acceptance: Headings, anchors and captions work at 200% zoom. Publish/restore changes article version safely. Related links resolve public records only.

title: Frequently asked questions `/faq`
sectionOrder: Introduction > topic groups > expandable questions > practical links > contact invitation
acceptance: Keyboard activation and state announcement work. Deep-linked question opens correctly. FAQ does not contradict protected policies or contact settings.

title: Contact `/contact`
sectionOrder: Contact introduction > protected phone/email/socials > brief choices > approved location/hours only > practical links
acceptance: Phone remains +91 8320404132; email remains rivyalivingart2.0@gmail.com. No unsolicited outbound message, newsletter or third-party embed is added.

title: Shipping and delivery `/shipping-delivery`
sectionOrder: Policy title > approved scope > process > responsibilities > questions > exact contact values
acceptance: Published approved policy remains the source of truth; no changes to territory, cost, timing or liability without factual approval.

title: Returns and cancellations `/returns-cancellations`
sectionOrder: Policy title > stages of a request > approved change/cancellation terms > contact > related policy links
acceptance: No new cancellation rights, deadlines or refund promises. Navigation and printable content remain complete.

title: Privacy `/privacy`
sectionOrder: Policy title > collection/use > references > retention > rights/contact > updates
acceptance: No private data in structured metadata or screenshots. Erasure and export controls remain authorized Studio actions, never public shortcuts.

title: Terms `/terms`
sectionOrder: Terms title > approved sections > business contact > related policies
acceptance: No fabricated business registration, address or effective date. Unknown legal fields remain explicit editorial blockers.

title: Imprint `/imprint` — first broken public destination
sectionOrder: Registered business content > approved entity facts > protected phone/email > relevant disclosure > policy links
acceptance: Exact draft preview, publish, public footer navigation and recovery need production evidence. Do not certify availability from code alone.

title: Accessibility `/accessibility`
sectionOrder: Statement > supported interactions > known limitations > contact for assistance > review date if verified
acceptance: Statement matches actual evidence and remaining issues. Contact route works, with no invented certification or audit date.

title: Loading, empty, unavailable, 404 and error states
sectionOrder: Clear loading/error/empty title > relevant explanation > retry/reset/back action > retained context
acceptance: Error boundaries preserve safe recovery; no-result filters stay editable. 404 status is real. Loading placeholders do not shift the whole layout.

title: Authenticated preview and development state galleries
sectionOrder: Authenticated preview banner > record and revision > actual renderer > return-to-editor link
acceptance: Unauthenticated preview is denied. Preview never leaks draft data into public caches, metadata, sitemap or screenshots for sharing.

title: Conditional workshop pages — no new route until an actual offering exists
sectionOrder: Conditional offering introduction > verified dates/location/format > booking only if supported
acceptance: No fake seats, dates, prices, bookings or availability. Activation requires real business content and a tested service contract.

title: Conditional 3D-printing/supplies or other legacy service pages
sectionOrder: Existing retirement explanation > current supported services > useful contact or collection link
acceptance: Unverified legacy routes remain gone/unavailable as specified, with safe destinations and no sensitive query forwarding.

title: Reviewed languages and legacy-URL journeys
sectionOrder: Language switch > translated interface > explicit editorial fallback > exact route preservation > legacy mapping
acceptance: Language choice survives navigation. Fallback is announced; contacts/product facts are unchanged. Unverified translations never auto-publish.

title: Saved pieces / legacy `/shop/wishlist`
sectionOrder: Saved count > product cards > unavailable items > remove/clear > collection return > brief links
acceptance: Reload persists supported local IDs. Storage failure is explicit. Unavailable records can be removed. No old wishlist import.

title: Registered custom pages / legacy `/p/[slug]`
sectionOrder: Approved custom-page introduction > typed chapters > supported images/actions > related destination
acceptance: Exact registered route, published revision, image provenance and recovery pass. Unknown custom slugs return 404.

title: Gone, maintenance, rate-limit and environmental states
sectionOrder: Specific gone/maintenance/rate-limit state > safe explanation > retry guidance where valid > useful return link
acceptance: Correct HTTP status and cache behavior; no token leakage via redirects/referrers. Recovery action cannot bypass authorization.
